intro: The next-generation bioinformatics platform. Solving the data problem in bioinformatics. The biomedical data is scattered into different databases for each of the domains. Our system integrates all of them into a clean, highly structured single unified schema that can be treated for large scale analytics and built intelligence on top of it.
foundation_lead: The entire data layer is built from 35 sources spanning 8 high-level biomedical domains:
graph_lead: Biofold represented the entire data into an enriched Knowledge Graph that carries up to Biological 15M+ Nodes · 254M+ Edges.
text_store_lead: Engineered up to 42.4M+ structured texts corpus in a searchable space.
bio_tables_lead: Highly structured analytical tables which unlocks pre-computed biomedical truth in milliseconds, engineered to power virtual screening, variant interpretation and personalized-medicine workflows with billions of rows.

text_store_left.detail: Names, Subcellular locations and functional annotations.
Compound-name, Curated drug indication, Mechanism narratives.

chemical_compounds.text: Compounds. 21 pre-computed drug-design properties per molecule.
Strict drug-like + 880K high-QED leads + 70K fragment-like scaffolds — virtual screening libraries, instant-ready.
Lipinski, Veber, RO3 and QED filtering at speed without RDKit pipelines to re-run.

integration_bullets: Variant → Gene → Protein → Pathway → Drug → Trial → Adverse Event → Publication
Genomics + Transcriptomics + Proteomics + Structure + Drugs + Trials + Safety + Pathways + Ontologies
arch_lead: An intelligence system built on top of a fully structured, computable, queryable data layer — orchestrated by the most advanced AI agentic architecture in biomedicine. Engineered to extract maximum insight and assemble viable biotech workflows and discovery.
arch_orchestration: Biofold can orchestrate long, complex, biotech research by streaming in a single reasoning loop:

system_use_cases.title: One-conversation drug repurposing
system_use_cases.path: Question → Chemical ↔ Gene ↔ Disease → Trial Evidence → Ranked Answer

system_use_cases.title: Genetics-driven target discovery
system_use_cases.path: Variant → Gene → Protein → Pathway → Disease → Drug Candidates

arch_closing: PhD-level biomedical workflows, orchestrated end-to-end — cutting manually stitching together 35 fragmented biomedical sources.
cross_modality_lead: A real drug-discovery query traverses through graphs, semantic searches on literatures and a numerical filter on chemistry and biology with model-predicted scores.
cross_modality_body: Biofold fuses all four in a single reasoning loop — symbolic, semantic, numerical and predictive — collapsed into one streaming answer.
reasoning_primitives_lead: Every biomedical question decomposes into one of a small set of recurring motifs. Biofold operationalizes them as first-class primitives.
